title: A Chinese Herbal Decoction for Stress Urinary Incontinence
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether Yiqi Suoquan Tang, a Chinese Herbal decoction, is effective in the treatment of female stress urinary incontinence.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of stress urinary incontinence
* Must be able to swallow Chinese hebal decoction

Exclusion Criteria:

* Urinary tract infection
* Neurogenic bladder
* Pelvic organ prolapse \> stage 2
* Overactive bladder
* Previous anti-incontinence surgery
* Post-void residual urine volume (PVR) \> 100ml.
